relevance_note: Case report of two LAD-1 patients with homozygous ITGB2 variants: "Homozygous c.920T>C (p.Leu307Pro) mutation in exon 8 and homozygous c.758G>A (p.Arg253His) mutation in exon 7 in the genomic DNA of Patient 1".
method_note: Read by hand; JSON assembled with a short Python script from hand-chosen values, every span checked verbatim against the paper by script. Table 2 has patients as columns (headers 'Patient 1', 'Patient 2'); P2 spans quote the row label through the P2 cell. Table 1 has variants as columns (c.920T>C, c.758G>A, c.262C>T) and gives ACMG classification per variant. Labels: P1 and P2 are the paper's own labels; P1's parents are not sexed ('both parents of P1') so 'parent of P1' and 'parent of P1 2'; P2's parents are named via the Figure 2 legend 'both paternal and maternal DNA' as 'father of P2' and 'mother of P2'. P1's sister ('His sister had no health issues') was neither tested nor affected, so not given a row. Contradiction: the Abstract and Discussion print P1's variant as 'c.920C>T (p.Leu307Pro)', while Results, Figure 2 legend and Tables 1-2 print 'c.920T>C'; recorded c.920T>C from Results/Table 2. Inheritance left 'not reported' for P1 and P2 homozygous variants: both parents are heterozygous carriers (biallelic inheritance), which no single inheritance enum value captures; the carrier statements are in parental_testing_statement. Pathogenicity/ACMG/variant type for the parents' rows left 'not reported' (stated for the variants found in the patients, not said for the parents). Functional evidence 'not reported': the paper states functional studies could not be performed; only in silico predictions (Table 1). Consanguinity for P2 recorded 'no' (parents denied it; Table 2 'No'), but the Discussion adds that 'consanguinity could not be excluded'. P2: 'minimal pus with redness around the umbilical stump' (history) and 'Periumbilical redness with a lack of pus formation' (examination) are both recorded; checklist 'absence of pus formation' set observed from the explicit 'lack of pus formation'. P1: pus was found intraoperatively and in cultures; checklist 'absence of pus formation' left not reported rather than excluded. P2 'Gastroenteritis (occasional)' mapped to checklist 'gastrointestinal infections'. P2 failure to thrive excluded from 'normal growth parameters'. P2 respiratory tract infection and sepsis excluded from 'were not identified in P2'. BCG complications excluded for both from 'BCG vaccination was administered to both patients ... BCG-related complications have not been observed' (group statement). Normal findings (D-27): P2 lymphocyte populations, immunoglobulins and DHR assay normal recorded as excluded abnormalities; P1 'anti-HIV was negative' as positive anti-HIV excluded. is_proband null for P1 and P2 (two-patient report, neither called proband). No stacked cells.
